name: I Ching Journal
releaseNotes: Adds richer canvas-drawn oracle card visuals, Single Hexagram / Three Gates / Five Directions spread options, deeper position-aware readings, expanded changing-line and transformation guidance, spread synthesis, and backward-compatible journal storage. No Android permissions.
description: I Ching Journal is a private, no-permission Android oracle and reflection app. It casts six-line I Ching readings with traditional virtual coin probabilities, supports one-card, three-card, and five-card spreads, explains changing lines and transformed hexagrams, shows richer card graphics, lets you browse all 64 hexagrams, and saves readings locally on the device.
